A flaw was found in libslirp. When handling ICMP echo requests, the reply length is not updated to match the actual data received from the host. Under specific conditions where the normal ICMP socket is unavailable, this length mismatch causes the host's real IP address to be leaked to the guest in the echo reply, breaking the NAT isolation that user-mode networking is expected to provide. 23/10/2026 23/10/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:N/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 3.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) LOW
